name: cancel_job
title: Cancel job
description: Cancel a background job. A queued job is cancelled immediately (status cancelled). A running job is cancelled cooperatively: a cancellation flag is set that the pipeline checks at its progress checkpoints, so the returned job may still report status running — poll get_job_status until it reaches cancelled. A cancelled job carries error code `cancelled` and the meeting's manifest status is restored to what it was before the job started (not failed); completed stage outputs are kept and reused by the next regenerate. Cancelling a job that is already cancelled is a no-op returning its current state. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown or expired job_id), busy (the job already finished — succeeded / failed — and can no longer be cancelled), invalid_argument, internal.

job_id.description: Job id returned by stop_recording, import_recording, regenerate, register_context or export_minutes.

job.description: Job state right after the cancellation request (cancelled, or still running until the pipeline acknowledges).
